notes.title: Kuboom - V4.1 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/e8a20809f99a288991b847f61278dee809cdd8ed.png[/img]
[h1]Kuboom 4.1 has been released.[/h1]
And with the release of this new update, we'd like to publish the patch notes for this massive content update.

[h2]Here are the highlights first.[/h2]

[list]
[*] User Icons
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/0f2c19e3b03828a0fd0113652765eee7fc08c948.png[/img]
As of this update, users can change their icons within the lobby and it'll appear on their friends list! It adds a bit of style and personalization to the UI.

[*] User Tags
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/1a3f9ae6a0a2cd2133d8e10f7341167790b6c9e1.png[/img]
In addition to having user icons, players will be able to choose a tag that will appear on the friends list!

[*] Region Selection
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/0a0ab47b27ca91d7a8b3c9b7d66fab4839d9cde8.png[/img]
Players are now able to choose the region for which they host/play games in! This will improve connectivity and will make the game much more responsive.

[*] Defusal
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/8dc33a59c3a2b2cf15a2107bc89f61ca45e05b38.png[/img]
That's right. Defusal mode makes its return with 3 new maps created specifically for the game-mode! Players will have to protect or defuse a bomb before it explodes! 

Keep in mind, respawning is disabled in this mode!
[/list]
Thats not all of course, We also added smaller additions. Such as the option to change the FOV or the crosshair with a sleuth of customization options to choose from.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/5ea3362776443c404e686946a3137d930fca759c.png[/img]

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added "Bomb" mode with 3 new additional maps.
[*] New map "Asia" is available for play in the Duel mode.
[*] Added Avatars and Titles
[*] New daily contracts system. Complete with achievements
[*] Two new skin collections.
[*] New black market | Secret skins will be available through here.
[*] Ability to adjust the scope and FOV
[*] Massive improvements to hit-registration and netcode
[*] Improvements to AI (Will navigate appropriately)
[*] Improvements to movement
[*] New weapon sounds
[/list]

We're dedicated to giving continued support for Kuboom, and we thank our players for continuing to enjoy these updates!

We have much more in store, so [b]stay tuned[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/c0b2548f084fbf7b6cc1cc9aa48c1c19a9e516b7.png[/img]

notes.title: Kuboom - Version 3.0 Release
notes.content:
[h1][b]Kuboom 3.0 Is here.[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/a77b36c77604b455e7810a4df7944746c450b40c.png[/img]

Kuboom 3.0 has finally been released and is the biggest update the game has received so far and the changelog reflects that, which is what we'll be getting into now.


[b][h3]Survival Mode[/h3][/b]

The biggest addition this update has is the brand new mode. [b]Survival[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/d9ba134602bb1bfd6239a41fda0e23f2dd2ac8df.jpg[/img]

In this mode you have to survive against a horde of zombies. Bonuses will spawn around the map
which will help you survive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/45ccfc77c5ccc2e2e4b4a189d077437982165817.jpg[/img]

If your teammates get killed, you can revive them! But be careful as they will be low on health and ammunition. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/b656e7cd4e8a51b345fc076b346582dd72eed1c0.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]Bots[/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/75f9cd19686a42f19f89b51efe20c782e1f1898f.jpg[/img]

Bots are automatically added to matches to fill player slots until more players join. You will
still gain XP, cash and rewards from Bot matches. Even if the entire game is a bot match.

[b][h3]Clan Wars and Clan System Overhaul[/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/67cdb90d00c313f78ce82b3323ee770dd32b127b.png[/img]

Clan wars are finally back! A long-awaited feature has returned in a new form!

The entire clan system has been remade from the ground up!

New features include a win/loss ratio..

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/acd35613b194b5d1b8e22d2d8dc519f1997a2db2.png[/img]

Clan chat..

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/fcf33370e1aa881f5a24cc61a32058e2c701756b.png[/img]

And more. Clan wars occur every few hours and when it starts your clan will go against another clan. The clan with the most points will win the war! Your clan will then be rewarded with Rating Points and Clan points. The higher the points, the higher your clan will be on the leaderboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/971872bad068015b744d7b55cf23667705d6a86a.png[/img]

[b][h3]New Challenges[/h3][/b]
There has been a load of new challenges and rewards added, and even daily jobs!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/b79031ef1cf79356c0663bb7c7650f0ee9f51784.png[/img]

You even get rewards for leveling up and reaching a new rank!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/1457195decf8b534c5e534cc61661969768db10a.png[/img]

The higher your rank is, the higher you'll be on the leaderboard! and players that are in the top 10 will receieve 100 keys every leaderboard reset.

[b][h3]New Shaders[/h3][/b]
The game has also gotten a few graphical improvements. New shadows and shaders have been added!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/0bc8bfcc056187c477c2147f9851cd6c5205d26c.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]New Weapon attachments![/h3][/b]

A few new weapon attachments have been added!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/77f3917894c62463012a309496399bdaff411b34.png[/img]
A Kuboom Inc. Kill counter has been added as a legendary item!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/1bfa3a41154f489d56b332521198cff3d6a927bf.png[/img]

New scopes have also been made available and can be found in cases or purchased!

[b][h3]New Skins![/h3][/b]
1 New skin and 2 new classes are able to be unlocked via Parts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/4b9b3eb63464efb21185021ae8aa05baf09a1f48.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/adb7780cafff41ea51d866f2d45ac7a911289366.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/89d4f3c3cb9387d2a6b4953c41ad39efe55d9906.png[/img]

Parts can be unlocked from opening [b]legendary [/b]cases.

[b][h3]New Items![/h3][/b]

And a few new items has been added to the shop!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/b55ba6bd0eb6e408c0ed5561c0f7765ae84e6905.png[/img]

[b][h3]New maps![/h3][/b]

There are lots of new maps that have been added in this update, I'll show just a few maps but there are tons more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/81f669053d6da69f3dac84b6dda707184c720c58.jpg[/img]
[b]Aztec - TDM/DM[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/248ccc34359c027b5e4f43f11f76dd191c057e4f.jpg[/img]
[b]Streets - Survival[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/e95e6c36d41d02efb8d31e45cc07ec296c8259ac.jpg[/img]
[b]Neon - DM/TDM[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/5b31a197825bb38b70a6925054c921a8d62184b9.jpg[/img]
[b]Shopping Centre - Gun Game[/b]

[h3]Theres so much more![/h3]
Thats not all this update has to offer! Theres alot more features that I didn't get around to covering. Some minor but the major ones are all listed.

We hope you enjoy this update! Stay tuned for more updates later on in the year.

Join our discord! - https://discord.gg/EZeZ8xu

notes.title: Kuboom - GLOBAL UPDATE 2.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/67b3487d52bfa795aee5fb3615b2c4eef7926c64.jpg[/img]

Hello Everyone!

The most anticipated update is here.. There are hundreds of changes but we're showing off the most important ones right here in this announcement!

[b]New Interface[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/490515853f4c8ca7e58f9c369b1a33fadcb4813b.png[/img]

We've redesigned the games UI and menu to make it easier to implement new features and options later down the line! It's much more clean than the older menu.

Not only has the menu changed visually, there is also a new song to go with it! 

Launch the game and take a listen after you're done reading this announcement!

[b]New Case System[/b]

Cases will no longer drop duplicate items! This means any skin/item you have in a case will not be selected.

[b]New Box System[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/d35f61bd02996bd912afc12a514696dbc1e67791.png[/img]

Another case equivalent has been introduced. Boxes are similar to cases but instead of getting a single item upon selection, you will now get 3 items of the same rarity! (more on rarities later) Boxes can be purchased with our new currency, Keys.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/9c42715dee0a31b6869f302210149f08e095b30f.png[/img]

There are are 2 ways of earning keys.

You can do the daily tasks to earn keys and you will also have a chance to earn keys after the end of a match via round end cards. At the end of a match, you'll be given a choice of 3 cards (4 If you have VIP) and one of those cards could have a chance of giving a key!

Of course, there are no duplicates here either!

[b]Rarity System[/b]

Items are now ranked based off of their rarity. Items with a higher rarity will have a lesser chance of being collected/Higher price. Items with a lower rarity will have a higher chance of being collected/Lower Price.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/69333c036048d4d3d2e69f20cf91a0cc8c321dae.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/e217a7d3e623ab62756b925a9b94046f637a4b6f.png[/img]

Skins, Weapons, Items and Modules can all have a different rarity and some items with a legendary to secret rarity can completely transform the item into something else!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/bab9b90a9f7324587a8bf01e8ae55f3fab8573a9.png[/img]

Rarity Categories are

[list]
[*] [b]Normal - Gray
[*] Rare - Blue
[*] Legendary - Gold
[*] Secret - Red[/b]
[/list]

Secrets are normally earned through tasks or events.

[b]New Maps and New Mode[/b]

We've added 4 new maps and a brand new game mode in this update!

Introducing: Gun Game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/80ef2ed9344e64ec2a1f0deeb9bf558649205a05.png[/img]

Gun Game is a free-for-all game but with a twist, every 2 kills you are granted a new weapon and the first one to get a knife and kill a player wins the game!

Its way easier said than done. But a unique game-mode nonetheless!

Along with Gun Game there are a few new maps for it as well!

[b]Village[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/022ea02c52c10a2c89aad1efafa6dc5886123baf.jpg[/img]

[b]Interchange[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/31c244d2a67ab3ca4aab572d9e22f6de8b6082d7.jpg[/img]

[b]Canyon[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/5ee3c5b2a2714a5e41733cd26641611794297c54.jpg[/img]

And while we have maps for Gun Game we also have a new map for team deathmatch named "Microdistrict"

[b]Microdistrict[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/6734962c216a9aa0e7d3d01e0fdcbb95dd24b917.jpg[/img]

[b]Additional Improvements[/b]
And with that we've reached the end of the major updates, so here are the not-so-major updates.

- Third equipment slot is now available to all players instead of just VIP players.

- Improved Netcode

- New languages: Spanish and Turkish!

- Improved anti-cheat and optimized the game!

- De-buffed the Clown characters.

- Fixed many bugs!

[b]Closing[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/76fab016fd6bc01979ad25f3238260faa31257e8.jpg[/img]

Thank you for your continued support! We hope you enjoy this update! 

As for what is planned in the future, We're looking at changing the core fundamentals of the game; Such as movement and feel. We're also going to bring back clan wars and overhaul it once again, and we're also working on something [b]very secret. 



Stay Tuned.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25962216/a77b36c77604b455e7810a4df7944746c450b40c.png[/img]

notes.content:

[h1] Hello Everyone! [/h1]

Long time no see!


[h1]So, whats been going on? Kuboom wasn't updated and now there are hackers everywhere![/h1]

I understand and we are sorry for this. We haven't been updating Kuboom on PC for a very long time. And we even missed the holidays!

The hackers will not be as much as an issue with our new anti-cheat which will come with the next update!

The second reason is I'm the only moderator going around banning the hackers! And so the banning process is much slower when there's 15 hackers a week..

[h1] But the mobile versions were updated! [/h1]

At first, we had Kuboom on mobile "just for show" and we didn't want that. So we polished it up. And witihn weeks the game became the #3 action game on google play! which was a huge milestone for us!

We were drawn in by the positive feedback the mobile versions were gaining and   wanted to expand on it which led to us not paying attention to the earlier versions of the game - you could say we abandoned our original fans and left you all hanging. All for a more popular version of our game. And we are very sorry for that.

So we are going to try managing both, the mobile versions and the mobile versions. And if we leave this game for a long time. I'll be sure to let people know around the community.

So, what to do while you wait? well if you have a mobile device - you can download Kuboom on it! we just ported it over to IOS and it is now available for download!

If you don't, thats okay! what you can do is talk with others in the Steam Discussion board! and if you want you can report cheaters and bugs too! 

Dont forget to invite friends! just have fun!

So, while we work on the next update. You guys go and play!

notes.title: Kuboom News - IN DEVELOPMENT! Mobile version of the game!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25962216/44f4920e49c473741866cb3d4646e5fd810aa4c3.jpg[/img]

[h1] Did you miss the developer diaries?😏 [/h1]

Catch full [url=vk.com/kuboom] information [/url] about what we are actively doing lately.

Many of you know that our games have a mobile version for devices running on Android OS. 

Sorry, we could not pay due attention to the handheld version of the game, so it was in a terrible state; It had huge problems running on slower devices, constant lag, awkward controls, reduced functionality, and many other issues. And there was a mobile KUBOOM just "for show" and we didn't want that. 

Now we happily announce the new mobile version of our game, which is already in the final stages of development and will be released soon! 

😎

We finished the following:

[list]
[*] We've spent a lot of optimizations that will allow to play comfortably even on relatively weak devices with decent FPS. It is worth noting that the graphics on mobile devices are practically identical to the PC version of the game.

[*]Brand new interface: The mobile version now supports all of the functionality of the PC version, including in-game chat, the minimap and your favorite inspected view of the skin.

[*] Changed the menu and made it feel more comfortable. Note that in the mobile version of the game is a function of movement, due to which they "Break Fingers", trying to shoot an enemy and at the same time trying to aim and press the fire button. 

Now you simply target an enemy and you will start shooting! Its really that easy! 😉

[*] We have also divided the server, from now on, Mobile players will no longer meet with PC players, and the battles And the battles for mobile will be smaller paced aswell as changed player count from 16 players to 4 v 4. The pocket version of the game will have almost every map from the PC version!

[*] Fixed bugs with the money and EXP accumulation.

For those who didn't know, note also that in the mobile version of the game has the ability to log in via a social network - Vkontakte. What does this give you? All your progress (experience, money, bought Arsenal) are combined and will be available on both mobile and PC version of the game. Play anywhere, anytime without losing what you've managed to accumulate!
[/list]

We hope you will appreciate our work on the bugs and take an active part in 
the general test of the game, which will be held in the near future! 

In the meantime, Heres a photo from closed beta test 😃

notes.title: Kuboom Progress News - Polls and whats going on.
notes.content:
[h1] Hello Everyone. [/h1]

Today, I have an update for you.  Well, not an update for the game! and update for the progress of Kuboom.

I just wanna start by apologizing to our fans for the lack of updates. We are trying to get as many updates as possible but new problems keep on arriving.

Dont worry, we are still working on Kuboom. Which is why this has "Progress Update" in the title!

Anyway, this post will focus on the things thats been happening behind the scenes.

[h1] So, why arent there any new updates being posted? its been weeks since the last one, and there was no patch log either! [/h1]

Yes I know, Mainly because the update just fixed and re-optimized the game. Nothing to special to make a post about. And second we are dealing with a few issues within the team again. 

Firstly, our main developer has stepped away from Kuboom for a while. He might come back since he has done this before. But that slows down the progress of development.

Secondly, our servers arent doing so well. Well not as well as before. At the time of making this post the servers are corrected but before they were slow, buggy and all around awful. So we were spending most of our time fixing that.

We are aware of most bugs but we are also dealing with personal issues.

Okay, so enough of all of that. Lets dive into the good bits.

I have set up 2 Polls for Kuboom.


The first poll which is about the decision to add destructible environment to Kuboom. We had a vote on this decision on VK too, but that ended and this is also for the steam version.

The second poll which is to add vehicles to the game. Of course the maps will be built around that idea. But we want to make sure the community is okay with these decisions.


Thats it! thank you all for reading this post and sorry about the lack of updates we have been giving you, we promise we are still working on Kuboom!


(We are aware of the black screen bug. We are trying to fix it. Thank you.)

notes.title: Kuboom - Dev Diary #1 - New Weapons and Others.
notes.content:
[h1] Hello Comrades! [/h1]

Today is the first dev diary!

Yes! And we will be discussing the new weapons and how some special weapons will be unlocked.

[b] New Weapons [/b]

We often get comments stating 

"When Will we get new weapons?"

"We want some new weapons!"

"When will the next weapon batch arrive?!"

[strike] "I want pizza!" [/strike]

"We need some new guns..."

Well, the time has come for us to reveal the new assault rifle "AK-74" and the new Sniper rifle "Hawk"!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25962216/86618f8147ca3b3f318e01086a4b708cf38beadf.jpg[/img]

The new "Hawk" Sniper Rifle

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25962216/f134fbe846ff3cc4c8335404362ff3d4bdfac2c7.jpg[/img]

The new "AK-74" Assault Rifle.

These weapons look epic don't they?

Well, these are gonna be in the game in the next few updates. However, unlocking them wont be as easy as earning a couple of Bucks to buy it.


[b] New Ways to obtain weapons [/b]

For these weapons you will need to complete tasks to unlock these weapons.

For the AK-74 you must Complete 10 tasks relating to Assault rifles. As an example:

Kill 10 people with an AK-47

Kill 5 People With an M4A1

Get 4 Headshots with an M4A1

etc..

Similarly to unlock the Hawk you must Complete 10 tasks relating to the Sniper Rifle.

Upon Completion you will be rewarded with the new weapons. Assuming this doesn't get scrapped like the keys.

We hope that this adds a new amount of skill to the game for experienced players and rewards them with more things besides Bucks.

[b] Anything Else? Whats next? [/b]

Well, While we are very excited to try those things out, we are publishing and polishing other games (Madness Cubed, Crazy Fun - Footrock, Killbot, etc.)
So if a new update doesn't go by, Just know that we are working on other titles aswell as Kuboom.

But! That doesn't mean that we wont give you sneak peaks at what will be in the next few global updates in Kuboom ;)

Mainly we are working on new gamemodes, maps, guns and mechanics (Ahem, Crouching?). We are also working on the mobile version of Kuboom and optimizing it for even lower end laptops and PC's

So, please be patient. We are making Kuboom better than it was 6 Months ago! Haha!

Oh and in other news, the Rambo skin and Knife should be availible to buy for a limited time. So go buy it fast!

And if you follow our [url=vk.com/Kuboom] VKonkakte	[/url] you will get even more updates!

Stay Tuned Soldiers!

notes.title: The History Of Kuboom
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Comrades![/h1]


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25962216/12a97f61707592c0b97f97f1bf7ffae20b91794c.png[/img]

It's the end of the year, and everybody is looking for reasons to celebrate.

Here at Kuboom, we don't need to look far. We've come a long way, and we know we owe it all to you, the players.

So in celebration of the year's success and the exciting upgrades to come,  we'd like to take you through a visual timeline of how it all began...


[h1]Humble Beginnings[/h1]

Feburary 5th, the day it all started. the original Kuboom artwork is unveiled!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25962216/a14150a7b0bea863801a23fda4f08ab0ad536811.jpg[/img]

We decided to go with characters similar to a game we'd developed earlier, Kubizume 2 (a.k.a. Madness Cubed). They were initially intended to have oversized heads, but a need for balance (the fatal headshot!) and aesthetic evened out the proportions.

[h1]Development: The Early Days[/h1]

Making Kuboom was an incredible learning experience; the team consisted of only 3 people (2 of whom were still in highschool!), and that lack of experience in C++, Modelling/Animation and troubleshooting resulted in countless bugs, errors, and sleepless nights.

But the team rose to the challenge, repeatedly ironed out issues, and never lost hope.

And out of that chaos, the Developer Diaries were born...

[h1]It's Alpha Time![/h1]

After 2 months of delirious development, Kuboom had its alpha launch. 
Our baby was not the most beautiful; ugly graphics, awful interface, tons of bugs and general glitches. We don't need to tell you, you were there! 

But hey, that's alpha for ya. We're proud of how much we've improved, and are glad you stuck with us!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25962216/d31aa8fd8d38c26a23b19fd62b3747cac23b68ea.jpg[/img]

Old Silenced Pistol Effect!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25962216/af7dcf91cfcbb99db17dfec05326395c3f79af65.jpg[/img]

The original preview effect. It got the axe in the steam release, but made a comeback in the global update!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25962216/64af3980dbc40044fc50c8871c07f4dddff4c92b.jpg[/img]

The old unreleased map, "City". Made for a great testing ground!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25962216/954922f3177cb3b5d13c381770f5fb591bfef123.jpg[/img]

More testing areas.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25962216/a7b140baa4856fe155e28ba0c2d32bcddc08b895.jpg[/img]

Shader testing for the map "Bridge" (and a bug that was also posted!)!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25962216/0fc20cdb8d1de8dacce781a748dfcb75cb41db1b.jpg[/img]

Very Old Prototyped Menu!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25962216/ac9c5273822504748adc43c0385a73981f754eaa.jpg[/img]

Old "Weapons" menu!

As you can see, pretty much everything's been completely rehauled, from the HUD to the weapons.

We also made new maps and improved the graphics, but that but that was in closed beta; the open beta is the steam release!

[h1]Steam Release[/h1]

On May 11th, 2016, Kuboom was given the greenlight, and a few hours later, appeared in the Steam Catalog!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25962216/20f7ab2be9fe0d62a7073463d8f671f79dc14564.jpg[/img]

We could barely believe it! An indie game, created by less than a handfull of people, created by [i]us[/i], was now on the steam store as a free to play title. 
And months passed, and the team grew (they "hired" me =D), and every day, Kuboom got better.

The much awaited first major update, the Global update, was released (and well received! (phew)) by the community. The main focus there was graphics and interface.

The second Global update looked at balance and smoother animation.  Out with stick hands, in with real hands!

[h1]Aftermath[/h1]

The results, after almost 12 months, speak for themselves:
200k installations on Steam
300k players on VKontakte
Ported to Android

And who's to thank?
We said it at the start:

[h1]YOU GUYS!![/h1]

Without you, Kuboom wouldn't even exist!

Kuboom has a great community of FPS fans who love chaos as much as we do. Thank you to those who've stuck with us from the beginning, and through all the tribulations. And to those who are just joining us, welcome aboard! 

It's a very happy new year indeed, because there are tons of things in store for the future...

[h1]Whats Next?[/h1]

Whats next for Kuboom?

Well. More bug fixes, of course. We have huge plans for Kuboom in the future, and troubleshooting is always an ongoing process. We're really going to need your help here, so keep reporting!

But of course, that's not all. We're also looking at:

More maps!

More guns!

More game modes!

And... *drumroll*...  did someone say clans?

That's just what we have planned for 2017 (most in Jan!). With steady improvement and your continued support, we plan to make Kuboom the best FPS on Steam!

So stick around and stay tuned, comrades...

notes.title: The History Of Kuboom
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Comrades![/h1]


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25962216/12a97f61707592c0b97f97f1bf7ffae20b91794c.png[/img]

It's the end of the year, and everybody is looking for reasons to celebrate.

Here at Kuboom, we don't need to look far. We've come a long way, and we know we owe it all to you, the players.

So in celebration of the year's success and the exciting upgrades to come,  we'd like to take you through a visual timeline of how it all began...


[h1]Humble Beginnings[/h1]

Feburary 5th, the day it all started. the original Kuboom artwork is unveiled!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25962216/a14150a7b0bea863801a23fda4f08ab0ad536811.jpg[/img]

We decided to go with characters similar to a game we'd developed earlier, Kubizume 2 (a.k.a. Madness Cubed). They were initially intended to have oversized heads, but a need for balance (the fatal headshot!) and aesthetic evened out the proportions.

[h1]Development: The Early Days[/h1]

Making Kuboom was an incredible learning experience; the team consisted of only 3 people (2 of whom were still in highschool!), and that lack of experience in C++, Modelling/Animation and troubleshooting resulted in countless bugs, errors, and sleepless nights.

But the team rose to the challenge, repeatedly ironed out issues, and never lost hope.

And out of that chaos, the Developer Diaries were born...

[h1]It's Alpha Time![/h1]

After 2 months of delirious development, Kuboom had its alpha launch. 
Our baby was not the most beautiful; ugly graphics, awful interface, tons of bugs and general glitches. We don't need to tell you, you were there! 

But hey, that's alpha for ya. We're proud of how much we've improved, and are glad you stuck with us!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25962216/d31aa8fd8d38c26a23b19fd62b3747cac23b68ea.jpg[/img]

Old Silenced Pistol Effect!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25962216/af7dcf91cfcbb99db17dfec05326395c3f79af65.jpg[/img]

The original preview effect. It got the axe in the steam release, but made a comeback in the global update!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25962216/64af3980dbc40044fc50c8871c07f4dddff4c92b.jpg[/img]

The old unreleased map, "City". Made for a great testing ground!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25962216/954922f3177cb3b5d13c381770f5fb591bfef123.jpg[/img]

More testing areas.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25962216/a7b140baa4856fe155e28ba0c2d32bcddc08b895.jpg[/img]

Shader testing for the map "Bridge" (and a bug that was also posted!)!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25962216/0fc20cdb8d1de8dacce781a748dfcb75cb41db1b.jpg[/img]

Very Old Prototyped Menu!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25962216/ac9c5273822504748adc43c0385a73981f754eaa.jpg[/img]

Old "Weapons" menu!

As you can see, pretty much everything's been completely rehauled, from the HUD to the weapons.

We also made new maps and improved the graphics, but that but that was in closed beta; the open beta is the steam release!

[h1]Steam Release[/h1]

On May 11th, 2016, Kuboom was given the greenlight, and a few hours later, appeared in the Steam Catalog!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25962216/20f7ab2be9fe0d62a7073463d8f671f79dc14564.jpg[/img]

We could barely believe it! An indie game, created by less than a handfull of people, created by [i]us[/i], was now on the steam store as a free to play title. 
And months passed, and the team grew (they "hired" me =D), and every day, Kuboom got better.

The much awaited first major update, the Global update, was released (and well received! (phew)) by the community. The main focus there was graphics and interface.

The second Global update looked at balance and smoother animation.  Out with stick hands, in with real hands!

[h1]Aftermath[/h1]

The results, after almost 12 months, speak for themselves:
200k installations on Steam
300k players on VKontakte
Ported to Android

And who's to thank?
We said it at the start:

[h1]YOU GUYS!![/h1]

Without you, Kuboom wouldn't even exist!

Kuboom has a great community of FPS fans who love chaos as much as we do. Thank you to those who've stuck with us from the beginning, and through all the tribulations. And to those who are just joining us, welcome aboard! 

It's a very happy new year indeed, because there are tons of things in store for the future...

[h1]Whats Next?[/h1]

Whats next for Kuboom?

Well. More bug fixes, of course. We have huge plans for Kuboom in the future, and troubleshooting is always an ongoing process. We're really going to need your help here, so keep reporting!

But of course, that's not all. We're also looking at:

More maps!

More guns!

More game modes!

And... *drumroll*...  did someone say clans?

That's just what we have planned for 2017 (most in Jan!). With steady improvement and your continued support, we plan to make Kuboom the best FPS on Steam!

So stick around and stay tuned, comrades... 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25962216/4215a6e980b6ae5fbf9102e7580599b2b84950cc.png[/img]

It's going to be a great ride.

[h1]Happy New Year Everyone!ːsteamhappyː [/h1]
